author: Mike C

title: Perfect Picasso
text: Jordi was a fantastic tour guide and had lots of knowledge. We enjoyed hearing all of the stories. He was someone who knew a lot about Picasso snd gave a great story. This was one of most personable and favorite torus of the trip. The museum was beautiful  and we were able to learn a lot about Picasso.
author: Pratik_P

title: Picasso Museum and private walking tour
text: The tour and guide (Angels) made understanding of life and works captivating. Angel provided a thorough pictorial album which added a better explanation of this artist. She also was very instructive of the history of Barcelona and Spain with this tour.  Would highly recommend this guide and tour.
author: Barbara_W

title: Julio was great guide
text:
Julio was well-preferred to guide us thru the Picasso Museum, as planned.  He had insights to add at every turn.  

We then surprised him and asked to tour some Gaudi architecture including the outside of LaSagrda Familia.  He did not miss a beat and gave insights and comments non-stop--including during the cab ride.
author: Joseph_J

title: Very informative
text: Learning about Picasso’s life and being guided through the museum to see and discuss Picasso’s most important paintings
author: Alan B

title: Highly recommended
text:
Picasso museum. Guide was excellent at explaining the various stages of his life and how they changed his art.
Walk down to the old city was very informative.
Bonus suggestion of a good place to have lunch… good food and cheap!!
author: LYNETTE_W

title: Angela was great! She...
text: Angela was great! She made Picasso come alive. The city is beautiful. Enjoyed the Quarter and Gothic sections.
author: Linda_G

title: So much to see! A feast for the eyes!
text: Was there in mid-October and love this museum.  You glide through all the phases of Picasso's work from the very traditional and classical beginning to the very abstract of the later years....interesting how his friendships with other artists influenced his constantly changing style.....all very fascinating!  There is so much to see.  Wish I had done more preliminary research so I could have maximized my time there.  The audioguide was a godsend....do not forego getting this with your ticket.
author: Travelbuff300
